name: benvds-skills
description: A learning coach built on learning research, and clear informative writing in Dutch or English.

interface.longDescription: Two skills. Active learning is a learning coach for a track of a few hours to several months. It builds a curriculum from your goals and prior knowledge, lets you try first or learn from worked examples, checks what you learned with a teach-back, and makes flashcards in your own words. Plain writing writes and edits clear reports, summaries, memos and other informative texts in Dutch or English.
defaultPrompt: I want to learn statistics in eight weeks.
Rewrite this report so management can read it.
